reviews.title: Good power supply
reviews.comment: Good trustworthy power supply. No frills just solid price for performance.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Reliable PSU for Budget Builds
reviews.comment: Solid performance and very quiet during use. The 80 Plus efficiency rating keeps it cool and stable under load. Cables are long enough for mid-tower cases, and installation was straightforward. Great choice for a budget-friendly gaming or office PC build — Thermaltake quality as expected.
reviews.author: Pepe DI

reviews.title: Perfect replacement power supply
reviews.comment: Great power supply, comes with variety of connectors, perfect replacement for my OEM power supply in Arachnid Super Shuffle
reviews.author: Robert Gagliano

reviews.title: Wonderful fit
reviews.comment: Would have been 5 stars but for the fact I had to go back and order an adapter to complete the install. Everything else was perfect. Delivery was excellent and wiring looked in the unit nicely. With the adapter the computer powered up like nothing had ever happened, which was nice considering family can be quite critical customers.
reviews.author: chrisb

reviews.title: "La guerrera incansable del presupuesto inteligente"
reviews.comment: "Si estás armando una PC de gama media o simplemente se te quemó la fuente vieja y no quieres gastar una fortuna, esta Thermaltake es un 8 de 10. No es una fuente para presumir en un concurso de overclocking, pero es la definición de 'cumplir con el trabajo'.
reviews.author: Excelente producto muy contento con su rendimiento con mi ryzen 7 5700x
